_comment: VideoSegmenter backend settings. Precedence: environment variable > this file > built-in defaults. Relative paths resolve against the process working directory. Point VSR_CONFIG_FILE at another file to use it instead of this one.

sam3._comment: Set enabled=false to run the backend without SAM 3 at all: no model is probed or loaded and /api/sam3 and /api/propagate answer 503.
